name: Taj Mahal
description: A white marble mausoleum on the banks of the Yamuna river in Agra, built in the 17th century and famous for its symmetry and inlay work.
highlights: Sunrise view of the main dome

name: Eiffel Tower
bestTime: April to June and September to October
description: The iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, a symbol of the city with viewing decks over the skyline.
highlights: Picnic at the Champ de Mars

name: Santorini
description: A volcanic island in the Aegean Sea known for white-washed villages, blue-domed churches and sunsets over the caldera.
highlights: Red Beach and black sand beaches

name: Machu Picchu
description: A 15th-century Inca citadel set high in the Andes mountains above the Sacred Valley.
highlights: Early morning entry above the clouds

name: Fushimi Inari Shrine
bestTime: March to May and October to November
description: A Shinto shrine in Kyoto known for thousands of vermilion torii gates winding up the forested Mount Inari.

name: Great Barrier Reef
description: The world's largest coral reef system, off the coast of Queensland, home to a huge variety of marine life.

name: Interlaken and the Jungfrau Region
bestTime: June to September for hiking, December to March for snow sports
description: A lakeside town between two lakes surrounded by Alpine peaks, a base for hiking, paragliding and mountain railways.

name: Petra
bestTime: March to May and September to November
description: An ancient city carved into rose-red sandstone cliffs, once the capital of the Nabataean kingdom.

name: Maldives
description: A chain of coral islands and atolls in the Indian Ocean with clear lagoons, white sand and overwater villas.

name: Banff National Park
description: Canada's first national park in the Rocky Mountains, with turquoise lakes, glaciers and wildlife.

name: Colosseum
bestTime: April to June and September to October
description: The huge ancient amphitheatre in the centre of Rome where gladiator contests and public spectacles were held.

name: Grand Canyon
bestTime: March to May and September to November
description: A vast canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, famous for its layered red rock and wide viewpoints.

name: Lucerne
description: A medieval city on Lake Lucerne known for the wooden Chapel Bridge and views of nearby Mount Pilatus.
